description: A crowded, chaotic interior: a man in a dark suit and waistcoat stands on a upholstered chair, raising a top hat with one arm. Around him a mob of rough-dressed men in brown coats and slouch hats presses in, some climbing toward tall open windows on the right. A punch bowl has tipped off a round table on the left, spilling liquid and shards of white china across the floor, with food scraps and dropped hats nearby. Gilt-framed portraits hang on the papered walls under a crystal chandelier. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no text or signature visible.
